title: Replace instances of g_malloc with g_new
description:
This commit replaces instances of
  (myobj *)g_malloc(sizeof(myobj))
and replaces them with:
  g_new(myobj, 1)
to improve the readability of Wireshark's code.

Replacements were made with the following Python script:

```
import os
import re
import sys

pattern = r'\((struct? ?[^\s\n]+) ?\*\) ?g_malloc(0?)\(sizeof ?\(\1\)\)'
replacewith = r'g_new\2(\1, 1)'

startdir = sys.argv[1]

for root, dirs, files in os.walk(startdir):
    for fname in files:
        fpath = os.path.join(root, fname)
        if not fpath.endswith('.c'):
            continue
        with open(fpath, 'r') as fh:
            fdata = fh.read()
        output = re.sub(pattern, replacewith, fdata)
        if fdata != output:
            print(fpath)
            with open(fpath, 'w') as fh:
                fh.write(output)
```
